_comment: GDD 11. Quest rules are deterministic: steps complete from game events and flags, rewards are fixed and saved. The AI Game Master may only RECOMMEND quests (by their topics); it can never change steps or rewards. Step types: talk(npc), win_battles(count), capture(count), visit(area), challenge(id), flags_all([...]), flag(name), open_chests(count).

fading_numera.title: THE FADING NUMERA
fading_numera.summary: The Numera is fading from Number Forest. Restore the three Numera Seals in the Ancient Number Ruins, then face the Arithmetic Beast at the old stone arch.

steps.text: Meet Professor Numeris in Starter Village.
Win a battle in the Green Meadow grass.
Restore the three Numera Seals in the ruins.
Defeat THE ARITHMETIC BEAST at the stone arch.

lost_numbers.title: THE LOST NUMBERS
lost_numbers.summary: Mira dropped three numbered stones while fleeing a wild VOLTIX. Each stone only answers to the right arithmetic.

steps.text: Talk to Mira in Starter Village.
Stone I: in the Green Meadow grass, east of the crossroads.
Stone II: among the crops of Sunny Farms.
Stone III: in Woolly Pasture, near the arena.
Bring the stones back to Mira.

broken_bridge.title: THE BROKEN BRIDGE
broken_bridge.summary: Bram the builder needs the plank and rail sums for the plateau bridge to the Sunsand Desert.

steps.text: Talk to Bram at the plateau bridge (east of the falls).
Work out the materials for the bridge.

crystal_seal.title: THE CRYSTAL SEAL
crystal_seal.summary: An ancient crystal on Waterfall Plateau hums with broken fractions. Solve them to wake it.

steps.text: Solve the fraction puzzles at the Crystal Seal.

unknown_runes.title: THE UNKNOWN RUNES
unknown_runes.summary: A stone tablet in Pine Ridge is covered in equations. Each solved rune reveals the value hidden behind an x.

steps.text: Solve the runes on the stone tablet in Pine Ridge.

hidden_treasures.title: HIDDEN TREASURES
hidden_treasures.summary: Old chests are hidden all over Number Forest. Explore every corner.

steps.text: Open 4 treasure chests anywhere in Number Forest.

stone_1.title: NUMBERED STONE I
stone_1.intro: The stone is warm. A sum is carved into it.

stone_2.title: NUMBERED STONE II
stone_2.intro: Rows of seeds are carved into this stone.

stone_3.title: NUMBERED STONE III
stone_3.intro: This stone is split into equal grooves.

bridge_plan.title: BRIDGE PLANS
bridge_plan.intro: Bram unrolls a plan. 'Help me get the numbers right and the bridge goes back up today!'

crystal_seal.title: THE CRYSTAL SEAL
crystal_seal.intro: Three facets flicker. Each one shows a broken fraction.

rune_tablet.title: THE UNKNOWN RUNES
rune_tablet.intro: Each rune hides a number behind an x.

seal_add.title: SEAL OF SUMS
seal_add.intro: The seal's light flickers between plus and minus.

seal_mul.title: SEAL OF PRODUCTS
seal_mul.intro: Grids of light fold into equal groups.

seal_frac.title: SEAL OF PARTS
seal_frac.intro: A crystal disc waits to be cut into fair parts.
